classification.difficultyReason: Compare mixed-number lap counts, combine or subtract them, and multiply by a mixed-number circuit length.

content.prompt: The school lap-a-thon circuit is $2\frac{3}{4}$ kilometres in length. Benjamin walked $4\frac{1}{3}$ laps, Nathan walked $5\frac{1}{2}$ laps and Alicia walked $3\frac{1}{4}$ laps.

answer.worked:
$$5\frac{1}{2}>4\frac{1}{3}>3\frac{1}{4}.$$
Nathan walked the most laps. Since each lap has the same length, Nathan covered the greatest distance.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What was the total distance walked by the three students?

answer.short:
$35\frac{47}{48}\text{ km}$.

Add the lap counts, then multiply by the circuit length.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Total laps}&=4\frac{1}{3}+5\frac{1}{2}+3\frac{1}{4}\\\text{Total laps}&=\frac{13}{3}+\frac{11}{2}+\frac{13}{4}\\\text{Total laps}&=\frac{52+66+39}{12}\\\text{Total laps}&=\frac{157}{12}\\\text{Total distance}&=\frac{157}{12}\times\frac{11}{4}\\\text{Total distance}&=\frac{1727}{48}\text{ km}\\\text{Total distance}&=35\frac{47}{48}\text{ km}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: How much farther than Benjamin did Nathan walk?

answer.short:
$3\frac{5}{24}\text{ km}$.

Multiply the difference in lap counts by the circuit length.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Extra laps}&=5\frac{1}{2}-4\frac{1}{3}\\\text{Extra laps}&=\frac{11}{2}-\frac{13}{3}\\\text{Extra laps}&=\frac{33-26}{6}\\\text{Extra laps}&=\frac{7}{6}\\\text{Extra distance}&=\frac{7}{6}\times\frac{11}{4}\\\text{Extra distance}&=\frac{77}{24}\text{ km}\\\text{Extra distance}&=3\frac{5}{24}\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
